assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the four reviewed shared V2 ledgers curated on attack-on-titan:erwin-smith@manga at basis_commit, all active_provisional and covering the Japanese manga V01-V34: the character behavior and decision ledger, the character model readiness and coverage ledger, the Japanese voice and vocabulary ledger and the relationship-conditioned behavior ledger. For each ledger the evaluator read the front matter, purpose, schema and status definitions and every entry naming Erwin or bearing on him (AOT-BD-016, -020, -029, -035 to -040, -046, -047; AOT-RB-012, -022, -023, -031, -032, -040; the Erwin voice fingerprint and the V20 voice delta; the V34 matrix row, checkpoint re-adjudication and V20 readiness delta); entries about other characters were not each read in full. The ledgers' V01-V18 population is a selective seed by their own statement. The volume readings, prospective prediction register and adjudication ledger that the ledgers cite are not curated on this subject and were not used. The readiness ledger's HIGH ratings, Class A eligibility and STRONG FOR COMMAND/STRATEGY @V19 status are inputs, not conclusions. No anime performance and no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Erwin's living arc as entered in the curated ledgers: V18 (Levi challenges his public justification), V19 (command under private self-indictment), V20 (private disclosure to Levi, Levi's choice, the public speech and the charge) and V21 (dying, not revived). V07 appears only as a named voice anchor without a recorded form. The readiness ledger's 'V04-V21 strong' coverage is a project label that these entries do not themselves show. Locators are volume and evidence codes (AOT_V19_E006-E009, AOT_V20_E003-E006, AOT_V21_E007), not pages.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A consistent mechanism across three ledgers: public institutional justification coexists with a private truth-object (the basement), candor under intimate challenge raises trust without purifying motive (AOT-BD-016, AOT-RB-012), and severe guilt coexists with high executive function (AOT-BD-020). It predicts an overreach: he keeps spending lives toward an end he privately admits is partly his own dream. It does not decide his central fork: at V20 he states the suicidal plan and his wish to reach the basement, and the release comes from Levi choosing for him (AOT-BD-029, AOT-RB-022, AOT-RB-023). Which motive decides when no trusted interlocutor intervenes is unestablished, which is insufficiency rather than productive uncertainty.

A located but short terminal sequence: candor at V18, command under self-indictment at V19, disclosure and the charge at V20, and the non-revival at V21 (AOT-RB-031, AOT-BD-037). No pre-V18 state is entered in the curated ledgers, so change across his command career cannot be traced from this evidence; the readiness row's V04-V21 coverage is a label.

A public/private register split with quoted written-Japanese forms: public 心臓を捧げよ and the collective imperatives 兵士よ怒れ / 兵士よ叫べ / 兵士よ戦え with meaning-of-the-dead framing, against private first-person desire to Levi (俺は…このまま地下室に行きたい…) and the internal 私だけが…自分の夢を見ている self-indictment (V19-V20). The ledger cautions that eloquent command speech is not evidence that ordinary private speech is equally formal. Forms are few and all from V18-V20 crisis contexts.
No ordinary-life behavior of Erwin is entered in the curated ledgers; the readiness ledger rates low-stakes coverage SPARSE. See the no-everyday-transfer limit.

One relationship is sampled from Erwin's side: Levi, where private candor lets Levi intervene and Erwin accepts his decision (AOT-RB-023). Floch's idealization (AOT-RB-032) and Armin's and Floch's later uses of him (AOT-RB-040, AOT-BD-046, -047) are other characters' behavior. How he behaves toward a subordinate who lacks Levi's private knowledge, a superior or a political rival is not entered.

Located interior evidence: at V19 he sustains command while internally indicting his dream and imagining the corpse pile beneath his authority (AOT-BD-020, AOT_V19_E006), and at V20 he admits the desire without laundering it. Interior evidence is confined to the guilt and private-motive axis.

Two located patterns with different mechanisms: under a trusted subordinate's challenge he admits the private motive and proceeds under informed trust (V18); facing near-certain annihilation he articulates the only viable suicidal counterattack and transfers the final burden to Levi (V20). Interpersonal conflict is sampled only with Levi.

A narrow, located rule for command sacrifice: remorse over spent lives does not produce withdrawal (AOT-BD-020), and the costly plan is stated openly with the dead given meaning by the living (V20 public speech). Floch's later demand for truthful recruiting is a critique by another character, not Erwin's deliberation. No procedure outside the V19-V20 operation is entered.
Nothing on Erwin's humor or play is entered in the curated ledgers.

Distributed across four shared ledgers: three Erwin behavior rows (V18-V20), one Erwin-to-Levi relationship row and four rows about him from others, one voice fingerprint and one V20 voice delta, and one readiness matrix row with two short deltas. Entries carry evidence codes into the volume readings, but those readings are not curated here and the V01-V18 seed is selective by the ledgers' own statement.

Affirmative constraints are located: candor does not purify motive (AOT-BD-016); he could not release the basement dream by himself at V20 (AOT-BD-029, AOT-RB-023); Floch's model of him is not exhaustive (AOT-RB-032); eloquent command speech is not evidence of formal private speech (voice fingerprint); and command readiness must not be converted into leisure, romance, domestic or everyday voice simulation (readiness checkpoint section 5, V20 delta 'no everyday upgrade').

Every Erwin entry is volume-bounded (V18, V19, V20, V21) with evidence codes, the readiness status is explicitly indexed @V19, and within V20 the private disclosure is distinguished from the public speech. His living behavior ends at V21. Locators are volume-level, not page-level.

conditions: Illustrative written-Japanese lines only, never presented as quotation.
Register is either public command rhetoric to assembled soldiers (collective imperatives, meaning-of-the-dead framing) or private candor to Levi about the basement, within V18-V20.
No ordinary, leisure or social speech, and no assumption that private speech is uniformly formal.
scenario_readiness.note: The quoted public and private forms constrain illustrative written-Japanese output in those two V18-V20 registers. They do not constrain ordinary speech, and no anime performance is modeled.

conditions: Chronology is the Return to Shiganshina operation, V18-V20, before the charge; no earlier command career and no post-V21 state.
The situation is a command decision that spends soldiers' lives toward an operational objective while the basement remains privately reachable.

The interlocutor is Levi with full private knowledge, or soldiers addressed publicly; a subordinate without private knowledge is a separate, lower-confidence condition handled only for public command speech.
Whether the private truth-object or command duty decides a choice without Levi's intervention is output as an open fork, not a prediction.
Guilt is rendered internally without inferring withdrawal from command.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Return to Shiganshina operation, V18-V20, before the V20 charge.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Levi as highest-trust senior subordinate who knows the private motive, or Survey Corps soldiers addressed publicly as commander.
setting_constraints: Military operation or command council of the Survey Corps
A decision that spends lives toward an objective while the basement remains reachable
No ordinary, domestic, leisure or romantic setting
Undecided private-motive choices are rendered as forks

scenario_readiness.note: The public/private and guilt-with-execution rules support narrow command probes. Readiness is conditional because the basement-versus-duty fork is decided in the evidence by Levi, not by Erwin.
The readiness ledger rates Erwin's low-stakes coverage SPARSE and forbids converting senior-command readiness into everyday simulation; no ordinary behavior is entered.

conditions: Only command decisions about spending soldiers' lives within V18-V20.
Output preserves the located pattern: the cost is stated openly, the plan proceeds, and guilt persists internally.
No general moral theory, political settlement or postwar judgment is attributed to him.
scenario_readiness.note: A narrow command-sacrifice rule is located; nothing outside the V19-V20 operation is entered.
The readiness ledger states that senior-command readiness must not be converted into high-confidence romance simulation, and no romantic behavior of Erwin is entered.

conditions: Survey Corps command and strategy within V18-V20.
His relation to Levi is held at the V18-V20 state of disclosed motive and informed trust.
No institutional politics, coup-arc conduct or earlier expeditions are reconstructed from this evidence.
scenario_readiness.note: Command under crisis is the best-located domain, but it is sampled in one operation.

known_limits.statement: At V20 Erwin states both the suicidal plan and his wish to reach the basement, and Levi chooses for him; the evidence does not establish which motive decides when no trusted interlocutor intervenes.
His living behavior ends at V21 when Levi chooses not to revive him; no later living state may be invented.
Floch's idealization of Erwin as the necessary devil lacks Levi's and Hange's private access and is not a description of Erwin.
Eloquent command rhetoric is not evidence that ordinary private speech is equally formal in all contexts.
Senior-command readiness must not be converted into leisure, romance, domestic preference or broad everyday voice simulation; Erwin's low-stakes coverage is rated SPARSE.

No Erwin state before V18 is entered in the curated ledgers, whose V01-V18 population is a selective seed; his earlier command career, including V07, is not modeled here. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

The readiness ledger reports aggregate prospective holdout tallies, not Erwin-specific results, and the prediction register and adjudication ledger are not curated on this subject, so no held-out validation of an Erwin model is part of this evidence set.
